content.comment_body: Hello, Is there any alternative method for accessing log files stored on the memory card of the [product_name]? Can FTP be used for this purpose if multiple devices are connected to the network? Thank you.
No, direct access through FTP is not supported. Only the most recent data log can be accessed via [product_name] or by physically removing the SD card and connecting it to a PC.

analysis.insight_summary: A user inquires about remote methods to access log files from the memory card in multiple [product_name] devices, preferably using FTP. Other participants clarify that FTP access is unavailable, and log retrieval is restricted to the most recent entry via [product_name] or manual SD card removal. This highlights the absence of convenient remote file access features in the current system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates remotely reading all log files from the memory card of the [product_name], ideally via FTP, without needing manual intervention or exclusive reliance on [product_name].
